Name: Tenacity!
Description: The unit may re-roll a single failed to hit roll in Combat this Turn. It cannot be used to re-roll a dice for an attack that has the Blast special rule.

Name: Tactical Retreat!
Description: If the unit performs a Back! order, it may move up to its Sp value, but may not make any pivots. This order may not be issued to a unit carrying a Loot Counter.

Name: Fight on with Honour!
Description: Units with the Hemicyon Trait only. For each successful result on the dice rolled to issue this order, the unit removes one damage it previously suffered.

Name: Pack Attack
Description: Units involved in a Combat with multiple Engaged friendly units only. The unit gains the Brutal (2) special rule.

Name: Bloodhound
Description: Units with the Hunter Trait only. The unit gains the Slayer (+nD3 - Combat) special rule until the end of the Turn, where n is the number of successful results on the dice rolled to issue this order.

Name: Sic 'em!
Description: Units with the Hemicyon Trait only. The unit gains the Thunderous Charge (+1) special rule.

Name: For the Greater Good
Description: Units with the Yan Trait only. For each successful result on the dice rolled to issue this order, the unit gains one damage but also increases is Sp by +1. No Nerve test is taken for damage suffered this way.

Name: Trawling
Description: The unit gains the Enthral (5) spell.

Name: Hardened Shell
Description: Units with the Sea Monster Traits only. The unit gains n Barkskin Tokens (see the Barkskin Spell), where n is the number of successful dice rolled to issue this order. The tokens are removed at the start of the unit's next Turn if still present.

Name: Aqua-venom
Description: Units with the Oceanspawn or Amphibian Trait only. This unit damages the enemy on a 4+ with both Combat and Ranged attacks, regardless of modifiers.

Name: Blood in the water
Description: This unit gains Vicious (Combat) on any attacks it allocates in Combat to an enemy unit that currently has one or more points of damage on it.

Name: The Healing Tide
Description: For each successful result on the dice rolled to issue this order, the unit removes one damage it previously suffered.
